versions.text:
The main passenger aisle width at any point between seats must equal or exceed the values in the following table:
{|
| Passenger seating capacity {r2} | Minimum main passenger aisle width {c2}
| Less than 25 inches from floor | 25 inches and more from floor
| | Inches | Inches
| 10 or less | 12 | 18
| 11 through 19 | 12 | 20
| 20 or more | 15 | 20
|}

[ The passenger aisle width at any point between seats must equal or exceed the values in the following table:]
{|
| Passenger seating capacity {r2 c2} | Minimum passenger aisle width (inches) {c2}
| Less than 25 inches from floor | 25 inches and more from floor
| 10 or less {c2} | 12 | 15
| 11 through 19 {c2} | 12 | 20
| 20 or more {c2} | 15 | 20
|}

The passenger aisle width at any point between seats must equal or exceed the values in the following table:
{|
| Passenger seating capacity {r2 c2} | Minimum passenger aisle width (inches) {c2}
| Less than 25 inches from floor | 25 inches and more from floor
| 10 or less {c2} | ^{1}12 | 15
| 11 through 19 {c2} | 12 | 20
| 20 or more {c2} | 15 | 20
|}
[^{1}A narrower width not less than 9 inches may be approved when substantiated by tests found necessary by the Administrator.]
